decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggression, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Feign Death provide additional utility and synergy within the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent and come out victorious in one-on-one matches.

The deck focuses on using powerful control cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up to play The One Ring, a powerful artifact that can take control of the game. It includes a mix of counter spells, removal, and creatures to control the board until the player can play The One Ring and dominate the game. The deck also includes cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Murktide Regent for additional threats and ways to control the game. The lands are optimized to provide the right mana sources for the deck's spells.

The main focus of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, and maintain card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The inclusion of cards like Archmage's Charm and Subtlety adds versatility to the deck, allowing it to adapt to different situations. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling a board of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. With cards like Young Wolf and Strangleroot Geist providing aggressive early game threats, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents. Combo pieces such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician allow for powerful synergies and potential game-ending combos. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility and adaptability, making the deck capable of dealing with a variety of opposing strategies.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, ideally Puresteel Paladin, and then deal a massive amount of damage in a single turn. The deck focuses on using cheap equipment and creature tutors to search for the necessary pieces while also utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to generate additional value. By equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature with Sigarda's Aid or Inkmoth Nexus, the deck can create a powerful and unexpected threat that can quickly overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It includes powerful control elements such as Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan, along with threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and options for the deck. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats and mana advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. With disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast clock. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Grief and Fury to further disrupt the opponent's hand and board state. The inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice allow the deck to protect its key threats and maintain its aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Death's Shadow onto the battlefield and use aggressive tactics to bring down the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional element of ramp and consistency to the deck. With a combination of efficient removal spells, disruptive cards like Thoughseize, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, this deck aims to apply intense pressure and win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using a combination of powerful control spells and the card "The One Ring" to dominate the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and protect its win conditions. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers and creatures, such as Teferi and Sheoldred, provides additional ways to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The mana base is designed to consistently cast the deck's powerful spells and support its control strategy.

The deck aims to control the game using removal spells and powerful planeswalkers, while also utilizing landfall triggers to generate value and card advantage. By managing the board state and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck can ultimately win through incremental advantage or by playing a dominant threat like Omnath, Locus of Creation or Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and The One Ring provides additional protection and resilience to the deck's strategy, making it difficult for opponents to overcome its control elements.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure through aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, while utilizing cards like Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt graveyard strategies. The deck also has some unique cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to further pressure the opponent. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggression to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on using creatures as a toolbox for combo interactions and synergies, utilizing Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for key pieces. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician is a central piece for sacrificing and manipulating creatures, while Grist, the Hunger Tide provides value through tokens. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Endurance and Blood Artist to control the board and drain opponents. The mana base consists of various dual lands to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors. Overall, the deck aims to establish a board presence while setting up powerful combos.

The focus of this deck is to use the card Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The deck also utilizes cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect the combo. The inclusion of Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending allows for additional removal options while Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional support. Overall, the deck aims to win through its creative combo potential and control elements.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly using Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands, alongside cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, to quickly play Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The goal is to set up a strong board presence and win the game using lands like Valakut and utility lands like Urza's Saga. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West for consistency and flexibility in setting up combos.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Calibrated Blast and Scion of Draco to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes lands like Boseiju, Who Shelters All and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect and support the combo. It also includes cards like Gemstone Caverns and Wooded Foothills to ensure efficient mana production. The deck also uses cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Shadow of Mortality to further pressure the opponent. Overall, the strategy is to assemble the combo pieces and unleash a devastating blow to the opponent.
